findings.explanation: PO-1005 is explicitly cited as a reference on both INV-1005 and REC-1005, yet no purchase order document exists anywhere in the transaction evidence, leaving the INR 59,000 payment without procurement authorization.
REC-1005 is dated 2026-07-18, three days before the invoice it acknowledges (INV-1005, dated 2026-07-21), an illogical sequence for a receipt covering the invoiced amount.
